benches.name: exact_p2l_s1
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_coll_p2_lane_ba_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_coll_p2_lane_ba_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 tools/mtp_p2lane_gate.py --out {RUN}/bench --cases p2l_s1 --raw -j 1
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 5b059065b snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_coll_p2_lane_ba_m5/src]
